Shoe inserts (generally contractually excluded); Corticosteroid injections; Debridement of hyperkeratotic lesions; Oral analgesics or non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs); Alternative or modified footwear that must include the following: Wearing well-fitting, low-heeled comfortable shoes made out of soft materials (e.g., canvas, cloth, soft leather) with wide toe box and padding;
